# Schedulytics — Complete Technical Documentation & Product Digest

## 1. Brand & Architectural Overview
- Brand: Schedulytics ("Schedule Analytics for Primavera P6")
- Production Website: https://schedulytics.app/
- Developer: Mohammed Farooque (Planning & Cost Control Engineer, Civil Engineer, MBA Project Management)
- Contact: md.farooque@gmail.com | LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/mohammed-farooque-jawaid-planning-cost-control-51052216
- Target Audience: Planning engineers, PMO directors, project controls managers, schedulers, and claims consultants in EPC, oil & gas, infrastructure, and commercial construction.

### Core Architectural Guarantees
1. 100% Offline & In-Memory Execution:
   - Schedulytics parses raw exported Oracle Primavera P6 files (.xer and .xml) completely within local system memory.
   - Zero project schedule data, activity details, costs, resource rates, or contractor information is transmitted to cloud servers.
   - Ideal for defense, nuclear, oil & gas (Saudi Aramco, ADNOC, SABIC), and EPC projects operating under strict Non-Disclosure Agreements (NDAs).
2. Standalone CPM Engine:
   - Does NOT require Oracle Primavera P6 desktop software or database connection to run.
   - Performs Critical Path Method (CPM) forward/backward pass calculations and float determination independently.
3. Transparent Perpetual Licensing:
   - Microsoft Store install provides a 30-day evaluation trial with active calculation engines.
   - Perpetual lifetime license ($24.75 USD on festival promo / $49.50-$99 regular) via Gumroad with dual-device Windows PC + Android mobile activation. No monthly recurring subscriptions.

## 2. Product Suite Details

### Product 1: Progress Schedulytics (PS · 01)
- Platform: Windows 10/11 Desktop + Android Mobile Companion
- Microsoft Store App ID: 9PJR22LWZFJ0
- Primary Function: Turn Primavera P6 XML and XER schedules into an executive reporting pack in seconds.
- Deliverables Produced in Single Run:
  1. 22-Sheet Executive Excel Workbook:
     - Automated Planned vs Actual S-Curves.
     - Earned Value Management (EVM) summary (BCWS/PV, BCWP/EV, ACWP/AC, SPI, CPI, EAC, VAC).
     - WBS level-by-level progress matrices and milestone variance tracking.
     - Built-in Excel templates for Engineering Deliverables (MDR), RFIs, Material Procurement, and GIS Lat/Long alignment progress.
  2. Single-File Interactive HTML Dashboard:
     - Standalone, zero-dependency HTML file easily shared via email or SharePoint.
     - Two-way interactive cross-filtering by WBS, discipline, contractor, and milestone status.
  3. Executive PowerPoint Presentation Deck:
     - Formatted summary slides ready for C-suite and project board presentations.
  4. Automated Delay Report (Word & PDF):
     - Period-by-period variance analysis and schedule comparison narrative ready for formal submittal.

### Product 2: Baseline Schedulytics (BS · 02)
- Platform: Windows 10/11 Desktop
- Microsoft Store App ID: 9PHV1LFVJ70J
- Primary Function: Automated baseline schedule quality auditing against DCMA 14-Point standards and Monte Carlo risk modeling.
- Audit Capabilities:
  - 22-Point Schedule Quality Sentinel: Checks open ends (missing predecessors/successors), leads/negative lags, positive lags, relationship types (SS/FF/SF), hard constraints, high float (>44 days), negative float, invalid durations, resource allocation, and Critical Path test.
  - Remove-Progress Clean Audit: Validates that baseline submittals are 100% clean and un-progressed before contractual approval.
  - Monte Carlo Risk Engine: P10, P50, and P90 completion date distribution curves and sensitivity tornado charts.
  - Submittal Deliverables: Instant formal Word audit report narrative and Excel compliance scorecards.

### Product 3: Recovery Schedulytics (RS · 03 - Upcoming)
- Specialized schedule health scoring conforming to Saudi Aramco Schedule Assessment Guidelines and SABIC specifications.
- Human-approved automated logic repair engine to fix broken relationships and out-of-sequence activities without corrupting schedule integrity.

### Product 4: Delay Schedulytics (DS · 04 - Upcoming)
- Forensic delay analysis software conforming to AACE International Recommended Practice 29R-03, SCL Delay Protocol, and FIDIC.
- Implements four standard forensic delay methodologies: Impacted As-Planned (IAP), Time Impact Analysis (TIA), As-Planned vs As-Built, and Window Analysis.

## 3. Step-by-Step Engineering Guides

### How to Convert Primavera P6 XER to Excel
1. Why manual copy-paste fails: Opening raw .xer files in Excel displays undecoded relational database tables (%T PROJ, %T TASK). Copying from the P6 UI strips out logic relationships, calendars, and hierarchical WBS structures.
2. The Schedulytics solution: Drag and drop the .xer or .xml file into Progress Schedulytics to generate a fully calculated 22-sheet formatted Excel workbook with formulas, S-curves, and EVM calculations.

### How to Convert Primavera P6 XER to XML
1. Reasons for conversion: PMXML compatibility, corruption recovery, web integration, and standardized database migrations.
2. Technical process: Schedulytics parses both formats with full data fidelity, extracting CPM logic, activity codes, and resource curves.

### The DCMA 14-Point Schedule Assessment Checklist
1. Missing Logic (Max 5%): Activities without predecessors or successors.
2. Leads / Negative Lags (0% allowed): Artificial schedule acceleration that obscures real critical paths.
3. Positive Lags (Max 5%): Hidden activity durations.
4. Relationship Types (Min 90% Finish-to-Start): Minimizes complex SF/SS/FF dependencies.
5. Hard Constraints (Max 5%): Mandatory start/finish dates violating CPM logic.
6. High Float (Max 5%): Activities with Total Float > 44 working days.
7. Negative Float (0 allowed): Indicates contractual completion is delayed.
8. High Duration (0%): Activities exceeding 44 working days without interim breakdown.
9. Invalid Dates (0): Actual dates in the future beyond the Data Date.
10. Resource Loading (100% target): All work activities have assigned labor/equipment/cost.
11. Missed Tasks: Tasks scheduled to finish before Data Date but still active.
12. Critical Path Test: Introducing artificial delay on critical path must delay project finish.
13. Critical Path Float Index (CAPI): Ratio evaluating critical path stability (target > 0.95).
14. Total Float Index (TFI): Ratio evaluating schedule flexibility.

### Primavera P6 XER File Format & Table Structure
An XER file is an ASCII tab-delimited file structured with:
- %T indicates Table name (e.g. %T TASK, %T PROJWBS, %T TASKPRED, %T CALENDAR).
- %F indicates Field names (column headers).
- %R indicates Records (rows of data corresponding to field columns).
- Key tables: PROJECT (project level parameters), PROJWBS (Work Breakdown Structure tree), TASK (activities, durations, status), TASKPRED (predecessor/successor logic and lag), CALENDAR (working days and shift hours).
